month_theme: The gauntlet — 4 subjects in 4 days, then Math P3

must_do.text: MONDAY MAY 11 — Final light review only: Econ key diagrams + Spanish B top 3 IO themes. No new material. Sleep well.
TUESDAY MAY 12 — Economics SL Paper 2. Data response and essays.
WEDNESDAY MAY 13 — Economics SL Paper 1 + Spanish B. Two exams today. Stay composed between them.
THURSDAY MAY 14 — Spanish B Listening + Math AA HL Paper 1. Two exams. Decompress briefly between each.
FRIDAY MAY 15 — Math AA HL Paper 2 + Chemistry HL Paper 1. Two exams. This is the last heavy day.
WEEKEND MAY 16-17 — Math AA HL Paper 3 prep: 2 focused sessions on style and technique. Exam Thursday May 20.

should_do.text: WEEKEND MAY 16-17 — Chemistry HL Paper 2 prep: acid-base equilibrium, thermodynamics, and redox key equations. Exam Monday May 18.

could_do.text: Northwestern Purple Prep — complete any outstanding mandatory orientation tasks.
After Friday: take a few hours completely off. You will have earned it.

key_dates.event: Economics SL Paper 1 + Spanish B (Written + Reading)
Spanish B Listening + Math AA HL Paper 1
Math AA HL Paper 2 + Chemistry HL Paper 1
Math AA HL Paper 3 — FINAL EXAM

notes: This is the hardest week of the IB. Four subjects, six papers, four days. The only job Monday through Friday is execution — no cramming, no new material after Monday morning. Between exams on the same day, decompress for 20 minutes and do not replay what just happened. Each paper is its own event. After Friday, two exams remain: Chemistry P2 (May 18) and Math P3 (May 20). The weekend is fully dedicated to those. You are three days from closing the IB for good.
